questions.question: What does it mean that green plants are producers? What food do they make?
questions.expected_answer: Producers make their own food instead of eating other living things. Green plants make a sugar called glucose, which they use for energy, to grow and to make flowers, fruits and seeds.

questions.question: Name the three things a plant needs for photosynthesis and say where each one comes from. What does chlorophyll do?
questions.expected_answer: Sunlight gives the energy. Carbon dioxide comes from the air and enters the leaf through tiny holes called stomata. Water is taken in from the soil by the roots and travels up the stem. Chlorophyll is the green substance in leaves that traps the energy of sunlight.

questions.question: Why are leaves good at photosynthesis? Give the word equation.
questions.expected_answer: Leaves are flat and wide to catch a lot of sunlight, thin so that gases do not travel far, and full of green chlorophyll. Carbon dioxide plus water, with sunlight and chlorophyll, gives glucose plus oxygen.
